Sure! You can trim your own notification emails in Meridian by opening **Profile → Notifications**. Each type (assignment, mention, status change, digest) can be toggled on or off individually. To receive only what’s assigned to you, leave the **assignment** notifications on and turn the others off. Changes apply instantly and only affect your account.

If you need any further help, just let me know!
